label: Seth Anson
how: Won the tournament for the title vacated on 12 November 2001.
note: The Ground Zero of 10 December 2001 has him defend it with Enforcer against Ben Archer and High Flyer, and books him against Archer in a street fight for Epic Warfare.

won.source: /promotions/epic-2001/archive/epic-2001-title-history.html: "The H.I.T. / Jason Winters / Decemember 23, 2001 / Epic Warfare VI"; his own card (/promotions/epic-2001/archive/epic-2001-hardcore-isosceles-trapezoid-biography.html): "Ground Zero - Decemember 23, 2001 (Reigning Champion)"

how: Beat Jason Winters at Epic Warfare VI in a Poisoned Pyramid Deathmatch, the stipulation he chose on the Ground Zero of 10 December 2001.
note: The title history names the event Epic Warfare VI and his card names it Ground Zero; the match and its stipulation are set on the Ground Zero of 10 December 2001 (/promotions/epic-2001/archive/epic-2001-ground-zero-2001-12-10.html), in A Rash Decision, credited to Sean Williams, and his own PCW biography says he won the title in a Poisoned Pyramid Deathmatch. The Ground Zero of 4 February 2002 bills him the current reigning champion (/promotions/epic-2001/archive/epic-2001-ground-zero-2002-02-04.html).
